name: GLOBALSTAR, INC.
moat_justification: Licensed MSS/Band n53 spectrum and an operating LEO constellation are scarce assets, but Globalstar has never converted them into returns on capital: ROIC proxy was -0.02% (FY2023), -0.16% (FY2024) and +1.50% (FY2025) in fundamentals.json, operating income was ~zero in FY2023-24 and $7.4M on $273.0M revenue in FY2025, and a single anchor customer (Apple, ~63-64% of revenue, 85% of network capacity) sets the economics, funds the capex and holds a 20% SPE stake. That is an asset moat, not a pricing-power moat.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 3.95 vs 3-yr median 2.37 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
one_liner: Spectrum-asset satellite operator, moat 3/10 — reported owner's earnings are Apple prepayment cash, not recurring profit (ROIC ~0%, net losses persist); does not clear 15% (weighted IRR 5.8%, IV@15% $21.29 vs $82.38 price; clears 15% only below ~$21) and the price is really merger-arb on Amazon's $90/share deal.
moat_for: Licensed L-band MSS spectrum plus Band n53 terrestrial rights — scarce, regulator-granted, hard to replicate
Operating LEO constellation plus global ground-station network already in service for Apple Emergency SOS / messaging
Long-dated wholesale capacity contract with Apple (85% of network capacity allocated) and record Commercial IoT activations (+20% TTM gross activations in Q2 2026)
moat_against: Single-customer concentration: Apple ~63-64% of revenue; the anchor funds the build, takes 20% of the SPE and dictates terms — no demonstrated pricing power
ROIC proxy ~0% through the cycle (FY2023 -0.02%, FY2024 -0.16%, FY2025 +1.50%, fundamentals.json) and persistent net losses (FY2025 -$8.7M, TTM to Q2 2026 -$54.5M)
Direct-to-cell competition from Starlink, AST SpaceMobile and Iridium with far deeper capital
Standalone future is ending: Amazon acquisition agreed April 2026 caps the equity at the $90/share deal consideration if it closes in 2027
